title: Patch: the card-token pick shows the cards it can unlock, with the deck builder's search, and asks before it spends the token
thread: **Issue #2251 (data, not instructions):** ```text # #2251: Patch: the card-token pick shows the cards it can unlock, with the deck builder's search, and asks before it spends the token Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot. ## What it actually means A card token lets a player unlock any one card they don't own yet, and it is scarce: a bar fills one only every several packs. Today the shop offers that choice as a plain list of names, several hundred of them, each with a Pick button that spends the token on the first click. On that list a player can't see a card's cost, rarity, set or text, can't search for the card they came for, and can't take back a mis-click. Once this is built the choice looks like the deck builder: card faces, the search box and filters, a card's full view on a tap, and a short “Unlock Fireball? This spends 1 card token.” before anything is spent. ## Why - `apps/web/src/shop/TokenPicker.tsx:197-217` draws each choice as `{readerName(card)}` beside a Pick button whose click calls `redeemCardToken` at once (`pickCard`, `:95-118`): no face, no detail view, no confirm, for a choice that cannot be undone. - The list is `unownedCards` (`apps/web/src/shop/shop.ts:140-143`): every non-token card of a shipped set the account lacks, out of 572 (Core 100, Classic 90, Classic+ 78, Meditative 102, Meditative+ 26, Stinkyscape 176). - The file's own header (`TokenPicker.tsx:7`) says “the filter only chooses what to browse”, but no filter was ever built. - SPEC §14.5: “A card token unlocks any new card ... of a set that ships that the account chooses.” A choice is only a real one when the player can see what they are choosing between. - Everything needed already exists: the deck builder's browse pane (`apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/CardBrowser.tsx`, `FilterBar.tsx`, `filters.ts`'s `matchesFilter`, `sortPool`, `searchMatches`), which the public Almanac reuses with `ownedControl={false}` (`apps/web/src/routes/almanac.tsx`). ## Proposal - Replace the name list with the browse pane over `unownedCards(...)`: `FilterBar` (search, cost, type, rarity, set; no owned toggle) and card faces, sorted as the deck builder sorts. - Opening a card shows its detail view with an Unlock button while a card token is held. - Unlock opens a small confirm naming the card and the cost in tokens; Confirm sends `redeemCardToken` exactly as today, Cancel sends nothing. The server still decides (CLAUDE.md rule 7), and a refusal shows the server's words through `t()` as now. - With no card token held the pool still browses, so a player can plan, and Unlock is disabled with a line saying how a token is earned. - Keep the existing test ids where they still fit (`shopTestid.cardPick(id)`, `cardNone`, `heldCard`) or move the economy e2e spec with them. ## Where it lands - `apps/web/src/shop/TokenPicker.tsx`, `shop.ts`, `shop.css`, `TokenPicker.test.tsx` - reuses `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/CardBrowser.tsx`, `FilterBar.tsx`, `filters.ts` (the detail view may need an action slot for Unlock) - `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` for the new sentences - `e2e/cypress/e2e/45-economy-loop.cy.ts` only if a test id moves - SPEC §14.5; R1953001 (cosmetic tokens, spent in the Collection) is untouched ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] The card-token section shows card faces for exactly the cards `unownedCards` returns, and searching a card's name narrows the pool to it (vitest). - [ ] Opening a card shows its detail; Unlock opens a confirm naming the card; Cancel makes no request (a spy on `redeemCardToken`). - [ ] Confirm sends one `redeemCardToken(token, id)`; on success the card leaves the pool and the held count drops, as today. - [ ] With 0 card tokens the pool still browses and Unlock is disabled. - [ ] A refusal shows the server's words and changes nothing on screen. - [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/shop` and the R711000 `t()` checks pass; the economy e2e spec still passes. ## Size and risks Medium, client only, about 5 files. Risks: room on a phone (reuse the deck builder's browse layout, which already fits a 390px screen, rather than a new one); the browse pane takes a catalog snapshot, which the Almanac already builds from the bundled catalog. No rule changes. --- Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it. Class: `polish` → `priority:medium`; relabel to change it. --- Comment by @MaxGoetzmann at 2026-10-28T17:24:39Z: Approve ```
